title: Comment-level Topic Drift Analysis in the Reddit Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2608.19133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a novel application of embedding-based dynamic topic modeling techniques to detect and quantify topic drift at the comment level in a massive corpus. By leveraging pretrained language models to generate contextualized semantic embeddings for short text, we analyzed 12.7 billion Reddit comments spanning 2006 to 2022. Using unsupervised methods on these embeddings, we identify dynamically evolving topic clusters over time. Our primary contribution is a methodology for analysis of semantic drift and discourse evolution in the embedding space itself. We also demonstrate modifications to existing methods that enable this analysis at scale, and we propose and demonstrate a null model comparison test to filter spurious dynamics. Key findings suggest that politically and socially contentious topics exhibit significant directional drift in embedding space, with inter-topic distances changing systematically over time beyond what the nul

translated_title: Reddit语料库中的评论级话题漂移分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19133v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一种基于嵌入的动态主题建模技术的新应用，用于在大型语料库中检测和量化评论级别的话题漂移。通过利用预训练语言模型为短文本生成上下文相关的语义嵌入，我们分析了从2006年到2022年的127亿条Reddit评论。在这些嵌入上使用无监督方法，我们识别出随时间动态演化的主题聚类。我们的主要贡献是一种在嵌入空间本身中分析语义漂移和话语演变的方法论。我们还展示了现有方法的修改，使其能够在大规模上实现这种分析，并提出并演示了一种零模型比较测试来过滤虚假动态。关键发现表明，政治和社会争议性话题在嵌入空间中表现出显著的方向性漂移，主题间距离随时间系统性变化，超出了零模型所预期的范围。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于嵌入的动态主题建模方法，用于在Reddit大规模语料中检测和量化评论级话题漂移，并验证了争议性话题的语义漂移显著且具有方向性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an embedding-based dynamic topic modeling approach to detect and quantify comment-level topic drift in large-scale Reddit corpora, revealing significant directional semantic drift in contentious topics.
